FR-001.title: A person raising a request chooses a Category and then an Item, in that order

FR-002.title: The Item step offers what the job supports plus the job-independent Items, and is never empty

FR-003.title: No screen offers a request type or subtype, and the type and subtype steps are gone

FR-004.title: A stored request carries its Category and Item and carries no request type or subtype

FR-005.title: Every request is one card: the Item's umbrella phrase first, its identifier second, which may depend on a captured answer

FR-006.title: One card layout for every Item; no layout variant is selected by Item

FR-007.title: An Item's own fields appear on the request page and never on the card

FR-008.title: The card keeps its four metadata rows: who asked, work centre, time remaining, waiting age

FR-009.title: A card shows the Item's picture, falling back to the Category, and never a placeholder over a real image

FR-011.title: A viewer can change the sort from a shell control and their choice is remembered for them

FR-012.title: Overdue requests stay visibly marked as overdue whatever the sort

FR-013.title: An Item's behaviour comes from stored configuration, not compiled-in code

FR-014.title: Every Item has a configuration row; a missing row is reported as unavailable

FR-015.title: An Item's configuration can change without a code change or a rebuild

FR-016.title: A request's deadline derives from its Item's allotted minutes, not from a type or subtype

FR-017.title: An Item with no configured minutes uses a 15-minute default, labelled as a default

FR-018.title: The minutes screen shows each configured value beside the average the Item actually took

FR-019.title: The average counts completed requests only, acceptance to completion, with a released-then-completed request contributing once

FR-020.title: Both configuration screens reuse the existing role gate and introduce no new one

FR-021.title: An Item's picture is configurable per Item; nothing configured never replaces a resolved image

FR-022.title: Every user-visible string comes from the existing resource mechanism

FR-023.title: The request type and subtype vocabulary is removed and the schema master lists stay in sync

FR-024.title: Every data operation goes through a stored procedure, with no inline statement text

FR-025.title: Every schema artifact ships its matching rollback and the schema master lists stay in sync

FR-026.title: An unavailable Item, refused action or failed read is reported in plain language, never silently

FR-027.title: Per-Item field definitions come solely from the configuration spreadsheet, which the application never reads or ships

FR-028.title: The four Items with no value source are not offered until that work lands

FR-029.title: The wrong-material Items read as one Deliver request carrying the correct part on the second line

FR-030.title: The Scrap Item's value is the job's scrap type and the user is never asked for it

FR-031.title: Scrap is offered only on a real scrap decision: set, not No Scrap, and not the Scrap Type Required placeholder

FR-032.title: Choosing an Item does not change the request's lifecycle
